breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard UDL midspan deflection formula δw(L/2) = 5wL^4/(384EI) rather than replacing the distributed load with its resultant acting at midspan. This matches the ground truth approach of using the proper superposition of two standard cases without any incorrect resultant substitution.
